visual_description:
The image contains three separate photographs labeled 1, 2, and 3 in orange squares at the top corners.

Photo 1 shows a woman in a floral sari holding a young child seated on an examination table; both wear face masks. A man in a green coat, also masked, leans over the child, appearing to examine or vaccinate them. Medical posters are visible on the wall behind them.

Photo 2 depicts a man in a blue shirt and face mask sitting at a glass-topped desk with his hands clasped. Behind him is a blackboard, a filing cabinet, and part of a computer monitor.
